programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E27
programme.desc: Al ver las fotos que hay del caso Corona en una cartelera, Lorena duda en confiarle a Omar lo que sabe. Pablo notifica que no le dará el divorcio. Paulina quiere que Gertrudis la acompañe a ver a la psíquica que hizo contacto con Marco Aurelio, pero su hermana la despacha molesta por creer en superticiones.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E81
programme.desc: Tamara arremete contra Clara acusándola de haber arruinado su vida al separarla de los dos hombres que ha amado.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E82
programme.desc: En la mansión Santa María, Clara Inés ordena a los obreros que se lleven a Pastora lejos. Llega Raúl, quien demanda que dejen en paz a su madre.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E031
programme.desc: Victoria trata de hacerle entender a Hilario que ella y Nicolás se aman sin importarle los odios del pasado entre su familia. Isaura y Carmencita están decididas a buscar la manera de convencer a Adelaida de que el verdadero Hilario no es el que le escribe las cartas. Yosmir le hace creer a Isaura que está saliendo con la hija del dueño de la carnicería para conseguir que la señora le preste dinero. Victoria asegura a Nicolás que no volverá a creer en sus mentiras, pues ya leyó todos sus correos y descubrió su plan; él aunque no entiende de qué le habla, le ruega que no se deje engañar por Hilario y sigan adelante con su idea de casarse; ella decide quemar Los Samanes e insta a Nicolás a marcharse de Cantarrana en la avioneta que le tiene preparada, pues ella está decidida a matar el amor que siente por él para siempre. Adelaida admite ante Carmencita que debe reconocer que Hilario nunca va a dejar de hacerla sufrir, pero ella tampoco va a dejar de amarlo.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E032
programme.desc: Aunque Victoria quiere que Hilario se olvide de Nicolás de una vez; el señor Guanipa está seguro de que llegará el día en que ella misma le pedirá que le cobre a Del Casal lo que le hizo, pues no va a poder vivir con tanta rabia. Fernanda se molesta al saber que Nicolás estuvo en Cantarrana. Nicolás comenta con Florencia que está seguro de que Fernanda se las ingenió para mandar desde su computadora un montón de cartas que le hicieron creer a Victoria que él la ha estado engañando; el joven está convencido de que la joven Zapata no es quien está ayudando a su tía y duda que haya sido Hilario quien contratara a alguien que lo hiciera como ella sugiere. Nicolás le cuenta a Fernanda de los papeles que encontró en Los Samanes; el joven asevera que, aunque Victoria los destruyó, él recuerda varios nombres y piensa que con eso, y lo que Rosendo le contara a Florencia, pueden empezar a buscar pruebas en contra de Guanipa.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E09
programme.desc: Adriana se niega a creer que Carlos Raúl haya dejado a su novia; el médico le jura que no le miente en el momento que Azalea se acerca preguntando de qué habla la pareja.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E28
programme.desc: Pedro sugiere que aguarden el lapso acordado con Gertrudis, antes de tomar cualquier decisión respecto a la vida de la enfermera. Claudio intenta cercar a Lorena con el fin de que desaparezca de sus vidas, pero la joven lo encara dispuesta a todo. Omar recibirá un video donde revela paso a paso cómo y quiénes negociaron la muerte del Dr. Marco Aurelio Corona.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E29
programme.desc: Claudio busca intimidar a Lorena, seguro de que no existe tal video que los incrimine; ella se mantiene firme, pero no revela su contenido exacto. En lo que parece ser otra de sus volátiles acciones, Virginia le notifica a Carmen que dará a su hijo en adopción. Lorena se sirve de la cámara de su teléfono portátil para grabar todo lo que sabe sobre la muerte de Marco Aurelio Corona.

A Felipe le extraña cuando Hansen le ordena que prepare una carpeta con todos los negocios que tienen en Cantarrana, pues debe viajar de inmediato para la hacienda. programme.desc: Conscientes de que Ignacio podría emprender una demanda legal contra ellos, Carlos Raúl señala a su hermano, con velada intención, que deben permanecer unidos.

La sorpresa se apodera de Clementina cuando Antonieta la busca para decirle que no se pude casar con Felipe.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E034
programme.desc: Adelaida aclara a Hansen que regresó con Hilario porque así lo decidió; el hombre sospecha que ella sabe lo qué fue a decirle, sobre todo cuando ella asegura que no verlo hubiera sido un alivio para ella. Victoria termina aceptando el reto de Jack y se lanza en parapente con él. Felipe acuerda con Clementina ir a una fiesta; la muchacha sugiere a Victoria que también vaya, pero acompañada de Jack Builder para que Nicolás se muera de los celos. Eugenia se disculpa con Yosmir por la forma en que lo trató frente a sus amigas y le explica sus motivos; el jovencito considera que si para ella es tan complicado estar con él debería pensarlo mejor. Hilario no quiere darle información a Florencia sobre el "negro Quijada", pero la muchacha le asegura que su intención es sólo pedirle disculpas al familia del hombre como Rosendo le encomendó.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E11
programme.desc: Conscientes de que Ignacio podría emprender una demanda legal contra ellos, Carlos Raúl señala a su hermano, con velada intención, que deben permanecer unidos.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E12
programme.desc: Finalizado el espectáculo, Adriana llora al recordar que quiso ser bailarina pero no pudo por la humildad de su familia; César, conmovido, siente que la ama cada vez más.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E018 - Episode 18
programme.desc: Berta está arrepentida, por lo que le pide a Abigail que luche por su matrimonio. Carlos Alfredo le presenta su renuncia a Ninoska. María Clara le dice a María Begoña que sigue amando a Carlos Alfredo. Álvaro le dice a Freddy que quiere adoptar a Cheíto.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E019 - Episode 19
programme.desc: María Begoña visita a Carlos Alfredo vestida de María Clara y le inventa que Álvaro y Abigail tuvieron una relación dos años atrás. Carlos Alfredo va a casa de María Begoña y ella le pide que la haga su esposa. Rosalba visita a Mariana en el hospital.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E29
programme.desc: Claudio busca intimidar a Lorena, seguro de que no existe tal video que los incrimine; ella se mantiene firme, pero no revela su contenido exacto. En lo que parece ser otra de sus volátiles acciones, Virginia le notifica a Carmen que dará a su hijo en adopción. Lorena se sirve de la cámara de su teléfono portátil para grabar todo lo que sabe sobre la muerte de Marco Aurelio Corona.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S23:E05 - Ruthin Part 1
programme.desc: This old Welsh Castle pushes Yvette’s team of ghost hunters to the limit and at least one of them doesn’t make it to the end…but who? Strange noises and sinister shadows seem to create an atmosphere of foreboding throughout the night.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E10 - The Sound Of Science
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds.Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they tune into the science behind sound. This week’s experiments hit high notes as we discover the physics of theremins, investigate how the outer ear impacts human hearing, and put on a laser show with cymatics.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E09 - Don't Believe Your Eyes
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. This week’s experiments delve into the possibilities of mind control, why objects and people tend to sync together, and the magical mysteries behind magnesium.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science - S01:E06 - Hot Hot Heat
programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. Damia pula mengejar cita-cita sebagai model, manakala Airel semakin tertekan apabila mengetahui Sara sudah bertunang dengan Irfan.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel dan Damia hidup seperti orang asing apabila Airel masih tidak dapat melupakan Sara. programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Shida mengaku dan menceritakan perkara sebenar, bagaimana dia terlanjur dengan Shariff, hingga akhirnya Muhammad yang telah menjadi mangsa keadaan. Muhammad menceraikan Shida. Arissa tahu apa yang berlaku dan cuba membantu Muhammad menyelamatkan AR Holdings dengan menawarkan diri untuk menceritakan segala perbuatan Fendi kepada pihak polis. Siti tidak sedarkan diri dan Arissa hubungi Muhammad.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Maisarah menegaskan bahawa cintanya kini hanya untuk Irfan. Dia meminta Airel supaya fokus pada rawatan sahaja dan berhenti mengganggu emosi mereka. Airel berasa kecewa tetapi akur.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Tokma dan Sara berusaha memujuk Irfan agar memaafkan tindakan Sara merahsiakan kegugurannya demi menjaga semangatnya ketika sakit. Dato Muiz pula memberi amaran kepada Airel supaya mempertahankan rumah tangganya dengan Damia. Selepas pulih, Irfan pulang ke rumah namun mula berasa terpinggir apabila Sara semakin sibuk dengan kerjaya dan kurang menguruskan dirinya sendiri.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Selepas ditegur Fatimah, Irfan sedar pengorbanan Sara dan hubungan mereka kembali pulih. Husin pula dibebaskan dari penjara serta berazam memulakan hidup baharu. Namun, konflik memuncak apabila Irfan cemburu melihat Airel terus mendekati Sara di hospital. Dalam masa sama, Damia menuntut penceraian, manakala pertelingkahan Airel dan Irfan berakhir dengan amaran keras daripada Irfan.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Irfan salah faham lalu menjauhkan diri daripada Sara dan pulang ke kampung untuk berubat, walaupun Sara tetap setia menuruti kehendaknya. Ketiadaan Sara membuka ruang kepada Aisyah mendekati Irfan, namun Fatimah mempertahankan Sara. Sementara itu, hubungan Damia dan Johan mencetuskan kejutan apabila mereka didakwa ditangkap khalwat.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel melihat peluang untuk menceraikan Damia selepas skandalnya dengan Johan terbongkar. DS Johari yang kecewa menyebelahi Airel, sekali gus membebaskannya mengejar semula cinta Sara. Namun, Sara yang pulang membuat kejutan kepada Irfan kecewa apabila melihat kemesraan Irfan dan Aisyah. Hatinya hancur, lalu dia membawa diri dan mula mempertimbangkan perceraian.

programme.title: Titi Kayu
programme.desc: Alim, seorang pemuda Cina Peranakan yang disenangi penduduk kampung atas sikap ringan tulang, mengorbankan masa dan tenaga demi membina titi kayu bersama seorang budak bernama Umar, meskipun tidak mendapat sokongan ketua kampung.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Ana dibawa ke salun milik Ricki untuk menjalani 'makeover'. Ricki enggan mendedahkan siapa yang mengupahnya dan Edora melarang mereka membuat laporan polis bagi mengelakkan publisiti negatif kepada Kleopatrena.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans pulang semula ke rumah setelah dibebaskan. Dalam diam Ira gembira kerana dia tahu Hans akan menjaga dan membantunya. Marlia tidak puas hati kerana Reez menarik balik laporan polis yang dibuat. Dia mahu Hans terus dibicarakan dan dimasukkan ke penjara. Rashid tidur di rumah Imran. Ira menyalahkan Hans di atas pergaduhan ibu dan bapanya. Sementara itu Hans pulang ke rumah Pak Leh.

programme.title: Penunggu Istana
programme.desc: Video realiti ini mengisahkan tentang pengalaman beberapa jurugambar dan lain-lain krew penggambaran yang sedang mengadakan satu tugas penggambaran sejenis makhluk asing yang dikatakan ada menghuni sebuah bangunan lama berupakan Istana Billah yang dibina pada 1896 di satu pekan kecil Papan, Perak. Sekumpulan penyelidik terdiri krew dan kakitangan yang terdiri beberapa lelaki dan wanita dengan penuh semangat dan dedikasi telah pergi ke lokasi tempat yang dikatakan terdapatnya makhluk / penunggu yang penuh misteri itu.Krew itu pada mulanya sangat gembira dan penuh dedikasi itu,telah mengalami kejadian ganjil,ngeri dan penuh trauma .Tempat mereka bermalam itu, yang merupakan istana bangunan lama telah bergoyang dengan sendirinya. Setelah di umpankan dengan benda-benda pelik oleh makhluk halus. Penunggu misteri itu akhirnya telah keluar dan membunuh dua krew itu iaitu Mus dan Fira. Seorang lagi penyelidik bernama Amar telah hilang.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah banglo lama yang menjadi tempat berkumpulnya Long Samad dan lima orang pelajar, Elina asyik membelek wajahnya melalui sebuah cermin kecil. Long Samad yang baru sahaja membuang sekeping cermin retak tiba-tiba bertanya sama ada Elina pernah memakai susuk.

programme.desc: Pandora pernah diperintah oleh satu kaum makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Eridian. Walaupun sudah lama berlalu sejak kaum Eridian lenyap, mereka meninggalkan serpihan teknologi dan ciptaan mereka di seluruh dunia yang menjadi asas kepada tamadun manusia moden.

programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah terpencil, eksperimen psikologi jenayah dengan tiga pembunuh bersiri psikopat, mesin AI dan LSD yang kuat menjadi huru-hara apabila pembunuh melarikan diri, mengganas penduduk tempatan dan mendekati keluarganya, mendedahkan motif gelap dan kelainan yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP6
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful AzmiJamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Menara Tinjau terletak Bukit Ampang tidak jauh dari Kuala Lumpur. Kawasan ini di bawah pengawasan Jabatan Perhutanan yang telah dibuka pada 2006. Dua orang Renjen Perhutanan berkongsi maklumat, terdapat mayat dibunuh dan dibuang di situ juga pengamal perubatan menjalankan aktiviti. Mereka pernah diganggu dengan lembaga Pocong yang menakutkan dan bau busuk semasa bertugas pada waktu malam. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi dan bau busuk yang menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Musim sejuk tahun 1598, kisah pertempuran laut terakhir Yi Sun-shin semasa pencerobohan Jepun ke atas Korea, yang berlaku di Selat Noryang.

programme.title: Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orang-orang kecil kelas bawahan di FlatSimpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan,bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak. Mereka jugaberhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antaramereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orangpenghuni flat tersebut.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya…

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: ReakSiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: ReakSiar

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Aziz M.Osman yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan filem-filem yang diterajuinya.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai “6 Jilake” ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Melawan Takdir
programme.desc: Filem ni kisahkan perjalanan hidup Quraisy Mathar sendiri (pengarah filem ni). Ia mengangkat pengalaman hidupnya yang penuh cabaran sejak kecil — kehilangan orang tersayang, jatuh bangun dalam hidup, sampai berjaya jadi seorang sineas. Cerita ni tunjuk bagaimana semangat, doa, dan keyakinan boleh buat seseorang bangkit walaupun diuji dengan pelbagai takdir yang pahit.

programme.title: Cincin Pusaka
programme.desc: Alina dan Sofian adalah dua beradik yang saling cemburu, berlumba mengalahkan satu sama lain sejak kecil. Setelah kematian nenek, mereka berebut untuk memiliki cincin pusaka nenek yang kononnya mempunyai magis tertentu. Tetapi pelbagai halangan terjadi untuk mereka mewarisinya. Mampukah mereka menghadapi segala rintangan demi sebentuk cincin pusaka?

programme.title: Madu Murni
programme.desc: Mustaqim, bekas guru mengaji yang kini bekerja sebagai penagih hutang demi menyara keluarga, berdepan konflik apabila isterinya, Murni, tidak merestui pekerjaannya. Atas cadangan rakannya, dia mengambil isteri kedua, Yati, lalu tercetus pelbagai konflik dan situasi lucu yang menguji rumah tangga mereka.

programme.title: Rudy Habibie
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan hidup Rudy Habibie ketika menuntut di Jerman Barat. Di sebalik cabaran sebagai pelajar dan peribadi, beliau gigih mengejar impian untuk menjadi jurutera bertaraf dunia dan membawa kemajuan industri penerbangan demi masa depan Indonesia

programme.title: Rock
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zack dan rakan-rakannya dalam kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bercita-cita menjadi terkenal pada era 1980-an. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai cabaran dan kejadian lucu ketika menyertai pertandingan Battle of the Bands demi merealisasikan impian mereka.

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Nun Mati Bertemu Alif
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Alif dan Tanwin, dua sahabat yang terlibat dengan sindiket mencuri kasut tetapi nekad untuk berubah ketika Ramadan dan memulakan hidup baru — namun perjalanan mereka berubah selepas terlibat kemalangan.

programme.title: Kaki Kitai
programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahan—dihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Shaw Prize Special 2026, The
programme.desc: The 2026 Shaw Prize in Life Sciences and Medicine will be awarded equally to Anne Deschamps, Dai Yuge, and Chen Zhu for their discovery of the molecular and cellular pathogenic basis of acute promyelocytic leukemia and for pioneering synergistic targeted therapy, which has transformed this disease from one of the deadliest cancers to one of the most curable cancers, with a cure rate of over 90%.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: The "Le Grand Tour de Seoul" is on its way again, with Samantha Ko, Kalok Chow, and Brian Chu set off to enjoy a fantastic stay in Seoul! The hosts will visit local Michelin-starred restaurants and savor top-quality Korean beef. Beyond the culinary adventure, the two male hosts will also have the opportunity to work out with Korean star and fitness icon Kim Jong-kook, followed by a delicious barbecue. The three will also enjoy personalized activities: Samantha will have a romantic date with a ceramic artist; Brian Chu will experience bespoke tailoring, showcasing his impeccable style; and Kalok will try on a styling session inspired by a top Korean celebrity, undergoing a glamorous makeover. This exclusive and enjoyable experience will lead viewers to the ultimate in Seoul's luxurious charm!

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! Hosts Chris Lai and Winki Lai guide viewers through different movie locations, revisiting classic scenes and memorable quotes, evoking touching memories. Follow the program's carefully selected routes to admire the dazzling cityscape and immerse yourself in the world of cinema. The hosts will also demonstrate photo-taking techniques, teaching viewers how to capture the unique charm of this "City of Light and Shadow" with their cameras. In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots; action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: The "Le Grand Tour de Seoul" is on its way again, with Samantha Ko, Kalok Chow, and Brian Chu set off to enjoy a fantastic stay in Seoul! The hosts will visit local Michelin-starred restaurants and savor top-quality Korean beef. Beyond the culinary adventure, the two male hosts will also have the opportunity to work out with Korean star and fitness icon Kim Jong-kook, followed by a delicious barbecue. The three will also enjoy personalized activities: Samantha will have a romantic date with a ceramic artist; Brian Chu will experience bespoke tailoring, showcasing his impeccable style; and Kalok will try on a styling session inspired by a top Korean celebrity, undergoing a glamorous makeover. This exclusive and enjoyable experience will lead viewers to the ultimate in Seoul's luxurious charm!

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots; action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Will Power

When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG.
